name: Clay animation restyle
description: Restyle the video as clay animation with sculpted forms, tactile surfaces and soft studio lighting.

prompt.default: Redraw every frame, from the very first, as stop-motion clay animation: every surface is hand-sculpted plasticine with visible fingerprints and rounded forms, lit by soft studio light. No photographic texture remains. Preserve the source subjects, action, camera motion and timing. Keep the visual treatment consistent across frames.
